factory.name: Stack.apply | Flex.apply | Grid.apply | Container.apply | Divider.create
factory.signature: Stack.apply(el: HTMLElement, options?: StackOptions): LayoutHandle<StackOptions>; Flex.apply(el: HTMLElement, options?: FlexOptions): LayoutHandle<FlexOptions>; Grid.apply(el: HTMLElement, options?: GridOptions): LayoutHandle<GridOptions>; Container.apply(el: HTMLElement, options?: ContainerOptions): LayoutHandle<ContainerOptions>; Divider.create(options?: DividerOptions, doc?: Document): HTMLElement

options.name: gap
options.description: Stack, Flex, Grid: gap step mapped to the space-N token. Defaults to the configured defaultGap.

options.name: wrap
options.description: Flex: wrap items onto new lines (false adds aui-flex--nowrap).

options.name: direction
options.description: Flex: row follows the writing direction; row-reverse adds aui-flex--reverse.

options.name: columns
options.description: Grid: fixed column count or responsive auto-fit mode.

options.name: minColumnWidth
options.description: Grid auto mode: minimum column width as a strict CSS length (for example '12rem'); sets --aui-grid-min.

options.name: size
options.description: Container: maximum inline size from container-width-* tokens.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Divider: <hr> when horizontal, role=separator with aria-orientation when vertical.

options.name: label
options.description: Divider: short centered text; also the separator's accessible name. Horizontal only.

options.name: decorative
options.description: Divider: hide from assistive technology. Cannot be combined with label.

options.name: defaultGap
options.description: Gap applied by Stack, Flex, and Grid helpers when gap is omitted.

properties.name: element
properties.description: LayoutHandle: the consumer element the helper applies to.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and apply options. Invalid options throw and leave the element unchanged.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the classes and custom properties this helper added, restore displaced classes and custom property values, and unsubscribe. Idempotent.

methods.name: isCssLength
methods.description: The strict CSS length check used for minColumnWidth.

cssClasses.name: aui-container
cssClasses.description: Centered, width-capped region with space-4 inline padding (default width container-width-lg).

cssClasses.name: aui-stack
cssClasses.description: Flex column with a gap (default space-4).

cssClasses.name: aui-flex
cssClasses.description: Flex row that wraps, with a gap (default space-4).

cssClasses.name: aui-inline
cssClasses.description: Like aui-flex with align-items: center, for inline clusters such as tags or buttons.

cssClasses.name: aui-grid
cssClasses.description: CSS grid with a gap (default space-4).

cssClasses.name: aui-grid--auto
cssClasses.description: Responsive auto-fit columns of at least var(--aui-grid-min, 16rem), never wider than the container.

cssClasses.name: aui-gap-0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10 | 12
cssClasses.description: Gap utilities mapped to space-N tokens.

cssClasses.name: aui-justify-start | center | end | between | around | evenly
aui-divider--vertical
cssClasses.description: Vertical separator line; stretches to the row height.

cssClasses.name: --aui-grid-min
cssClasses.description: Custom property: minimum column width in auto mode (default 16rem).
